name: PhD in Molecular and Cellular Biology
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 1 deadline is published without a year and is not confirmed for Fall 2027. How PhD students are admitted (program or lab), the application fee amount and funding are not stated on the pages checked.
summary: PhD program in molecular and cellular biology at UMass Amherst, with faculty from the university and nearby colleges. Applications open for fall entry only through the Graduate School.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published PhD application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The program pages say "December 1 each year" and give no year. Not confirmed for Fall 2027; confirm with the program.

english.note: Graduate School minimums for international applicants. A waiver applies for citizens of listed English-speaking countries, holders of a degree from the US or those countries, and some others; waived applicants are reviewed if recommended for admission.

documents: TOEFL (or other accepted test) and Financial Statement (international applicants only)
requirements.note: An application fee is required; the amount and any fee waiver are not stated on the program page. Applicants are expected to have college-level biology, organic chemistry, calculus and physics. A file is generally not reviewed until all materials are received.

international.note: International applicants must show advance proof of funding sufficient for a full 12-month year (Graduate School page).
